compute_file_hash: compute the MD5 hash of a file given its file path
compute_tasks_hash: compute the MD5 hash of a sorted list of task IDs from a tasks dictionary
compute_creator_hash: compute the MD5 hash of all Python files in the PHYRE creator directory
get_solution_path: get the file path string for a task solution given task and solution IDs
stable_shuffle: stably shuffle a list of strings using MD5-based deterministic sorting with an optional salt
